name: dm4310_24v_pitch
parameter_scope: Synthetic illustrative pitched load, not identified from a RoboMaster vehicle. The motor protocol and envelope are inherited from the linked simulation-only motor profile.
coordinate_convention: theta=0 is horizontal; positive theta and positive motor torque raise the barrel. Plant equation J*theta_ddot=tau_motor-B*theta_dot-C*tanh(theta_dot/vc)-G(theta)+tau_external; G=A*cos(theta)+B*sin(theta).
fixed_comparison_contract: All three variants receive identical J/B/Kp/Kv/Ki, integral cap, ESO settings and total torque/slew limits. Original means the unchanged pinned upstream C with matching Ki. The two new variants differ only in the gravity model. No Ki0 baseline is substituted for GM6020.
scope_notes: Gravity amplitude sqrt(0.45^2+0.10^2)=0.461 Nm corresponds to an illustrative mass-offset product 0.047 kg m; it is not a typical population parameter.

No hard-stop contact, elastic backlash, gravity vector estimation, chassis tilt or coupled yaw-pitch dynamics is simulated. A boundary crossing is a failed trajectory and is never clipped into a successful trace.
A zero software torque after a pitch fault is not a brake or safe hold. Mechanical support and system-level power/brake handling remain required.
